key_findings: Review: berberine relieves diabetic, chemotherapy and nerve-injury pain via TRPV1 down-regulation, NF-kB suppression and opioid receptor modulation.
Berberine represses TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta, PGE2, iNOS and COX-2 and induces Nrf2.
